rules_library.name: opposite_parity_as_last

rules_library.name: color_alternates_every_two
rules_library.description: Colors stay the same for two consecutive cards, then switch for the next two, and so on.
rules_library.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
# Determine the block index (0-based) by integer division of position by 2
pos = len(mainline)          # position where this card would be placed (0-based)
block = pos // 2
# Even blocks keep the color of the first card in the block,
# odd blocks require the opposite color.
if block == 0:
    return True
first_in_block = mainline[pos-1] if pos % 2 == 0 else mainline[pos-2]
if block % 2 == 0:
    return card.color == first_in_block.color
else:
    return card.color != first_in_block.color

return card.suit.suit_name == expected

rules_library.name: suit_match_two_back
